card.name: Dosing instruction wording before a dose
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions that come just before a new dose amount or drug name: mg after a starting number, increase or dosage after an instruction verb, and the middle of discontinue or subcutaneous.

modes.label: Unit after dose number
modes.description: The unit mg right after a dose number in a titration or starting-dose instruction.
modes.example: Consider initiating riociguat tablets at a starting dose of 0.5<< mg>> in patients at risk of hypotension

modes.label: Change-dose verbs
modes.description: Increase, or dosage after increase or reduce, leading into a new amount.
modes.example: Increase the<< dosage>> by 1.25 mg twice

modes.label: Inside discontinue or subcutaneous
modes.description: The later part of the words discontinue or subcutaneous, in an instruction.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing instruction where a dose change or new amount is about to be given.
